units_with_origins.source: 애플리케이션은 카메라를 처리할 준비가 되기 전에 확보하고 구성해야 하며, 시작한 후 요청을 처리하다가 완료되면 정지한 뒤 반드시 해제해야 합니다.
units_with_origins.translation: The application must acquire and configure the camera before it is ready to process requests. After starting the camera, it processes requests until it is stopped; when the application finishes processing requests, it must stop the camera and then release it.

units_with_origins.source: 요청을 완료해야 하는 파이프라인 핸들러는 {{1}} 함수를 명시적으로 호출하여 요청을 완료해야 합니다.
units_with_origins.translation: The pipeline handler that must complete the request must explicitly call the {{1}} Function to complete the request.

units_with_origins.translation: To notify the application that the buffer portion of a request has been completed and to update the buffer tracking within the request, the pipeline handler must always call the {{1}} function.

units_with_origins.translation: If the release is not performed, the application can start and stop the camera multiple times, during which it is also possible to re-configure the camera settings.
